route: formal abstraction, lossy causal mapping, adversarial mapping-capacity theory, dynamical behavioral similarity, abstraction-assisted structural mapping, intervention tooling

sources.source: Geiger et al., Causal Abstraction: A Theoretical Foundation for Mechanistic Interpretability, JMLR 26(83), 2025
sources.projection: Causal abstraction can be defined through explicit transformations between mechanisms and intervention semantics, including arbitrary mechanism transformations.
rakl_mapping: TRANSFORMABLE_TO needs intervention/query semantics when used causally
static representational alignment alone is insufficient for causal or mechanistic authority
sources.novelty_effect: prior art; do not claim explicit cross-level causal transformation as RAKL novelty

sources.source: Xia and Bareinboim, Causal Abstraction Inference under Lossy Representations, ICML/PMLR 267, 2025
sources.projection: Standard abstraction assumptions can fail under lossy representations when multiple low-level interventions map to the same high-level intervention but have different effects; projected abstractions recover scoped query translation.
rakl_mapping: erasure ledger must identify which probe/query families remain valid
lossy maps may justify partial/projected relations rather than full causal equivalence
sources.novelty_effect: narrows any claim that RAKL originated lossy-abstraction handling

sources.source: Sutter et al., The Non-Linear Representation Dilemma: Is Causal Abstraction Enough for Mechanistic Interpretability?, arXiv:2507.08802, 2025
sources.projection: Arbitrarily expressive nonlinear alignment maps can make causal-abstraction-style correspondences vacuous; mapping accuracy needs assumptions on encoding/alignment capacity.
rakl_mapping: mapping witness strength depends on a predeclared admissible mapping family
post-hoc expansion of mapping capacity is a scientific failure mode
discovery maps and certification maps should have different authority
sources.novelty_effect: strong prior-art/adversarial refuter against naive witnessed-similarity claims

sources.source: Tao, Xu and You, A Theoretical Analysis of State Similarity Between Markov Decision Processes, arXiv:2512.17265, 2025
sources.projection: Generalized bisimulation metrics provide a rigorous behavioral-similarity relation across pairs of MDPs and establish metric properties.
rakl_mapping: future transition behavior can define a dynamical-similarity local chart
snapshot similarity must not mint trajectory-level equivalence
sources.novelty_effect: bisimulation and behavioral state similarity are established prior art

sources.source: Roh, Bae and Choi, PAMD: Structured Adaptive Distances for Bisimulation Representations in Visual Reinforcement Learning, arXiv:2607.18004, 2026
sources.projection: Unconstrained pairwise distances can admit degenerate solutions; expressive behavioral metrics benefit from structural constraints.
rakl_mapping: reinforces capacity-controlled similarity rather than unconstrained pair scoring
structured expressivity is preferable to either one fixed norm or fully free pairwise fitting
sources.novelty_effect: reinforces but does not duplicate RAKL's broader map-admissibility contract

sources.source: Khojasteh et al., Enhancing Structural Mapping with LLM-derived Abstractions for Analogical Reasoning in Narratives, arXiv:2603.29997, 2026
sources.projection: A modular decompose-abstract-map pipeline with multiple abstraction levels improves analogical reasoning; choosing abstraction level and handling implicit causality remain failure modes.
rakl_mapping: L0-L6 abstraction level should be experimentally selected rather than assumed monotone in quality
LLM abstraction and structural mapping should remain separable modules
sources.novelty_effect: abstraction-assisted structural mapping is prior art; RAKL novelty must be narrower

sources.projection: Provides a concrete intervention API used for causal abstraction and model-intervention studies.
rakl_mapping: tool execution does not itself identify scientific causality

not_counted_as_novel: the warning that unrestricted nonlinear alignment can be vacuous
remaining_novelty_question: Whether the specific RAKL composition of query-family-indexed equivalence, immutable distinguishing-probe certificates, relation-specific predeclared mapping-capacity contracts, and discovery/certification authority separation has a prior semantically equivalent scientific-research framework.
